sentences.full: Dylan shared a close-up photo of my face in the group chat.
sentences.cn: Dylan 在群組聊天中分享了一張我的臉部特寫照片。

sentences.full: I was so embarrassed because it showed my acne.
sentences.cn: 我十分尷尬，因為照片拍到了我的暗瘡。

sentences.full: I was puzzled about why he did that to me, so I decided to ignore him.
sentences.cn: 我不明白他為甚麼這樣對我，所以我決定不理會他。

sentences.full: A few days later, Dylan called me. He said he didn’t mean to hurt my feelings.
sentences.cn: 幾天後，Dylan 打電話給我。他說他不是有意傷害我的感受。

sentences.full: It is good to patch things up with my good friend.
sentences.cn: 能夠與我的好朋友和好是一件好事。
